intro: I speak about building and operating AI systems, and the security and standards needed to use them responsibly. My talks draw on engineering work and contributions across AAIF, Appia, and CoSAI, with practical examples of what works, what fails, and what remains unproven.

topics.title: Building AI systems for production
topics.detail: Architecture, reliability, and operating AI at scale: from models and agent workflows to tools, data, and infrastructure. Practical lessons on deployment, evaluation, observability, and the trade-offs teams face in production.

topics.title: AI security, governance, and open standards
topics.detail: How organizations control AI systems and assess the evidence behind them. Topics include agent identity and interoperability, authorization, confidential computing, model custody, auditability, and turning risk-management requirements into engineering controls.

book.title: Architecting at Scale
book.line: Author of Architecting at Scale (Packt, 2026), a field guide to large-scale AI-native system design.
